page.layout: One column of text, with a date line in italic, then a division heading "EPIST. XIII.", a hanging-indent title block, and a catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rem,unum adhuc mihi superesse animad-vertens, cui illud confecrem, potiorem te neminem habeo: quæstiones magni exagitatPræfatio ista, qua industria judex esto vir docte, sententiam tuam qvæcunqve futura sit, lubens amplectar; qvā-qvam[?] opusculum istud rebus aliis implicitum sit, Bibliaqve ipsa in Belgium aut jā pervenerint, aut brevi perventura sint, illud tamen offerre tibi solitarium minime erubesco: ut possim munus tuum hoc qvalicunqve gratitudinis meæ testimonio remunerari, bene volentiamqve tuam mihi nostraqve Congregationi promereri.
main_text.head: EPIST. XIII.
Joh. Morinus, Nob. viro Petro à Valle de Alphabeto Linguæ Ægyptiacæ, simulqve de exemplari M. S. Evangeliorum Lingua Coptica; de Samaritanorum Pentateucho eorumqve Lingua.

page.notes: The word "qvā-qvam" at the line end is doubtful; the hyphen and the second word are unclear, so it is marked [?]. The printed text has no space between "exagitat" and "Præfatio"; this is left as printed. The date "1628" has a small trailing mark that could be a superscript; it is copied as 1628. The catchword "Nobi-" is printed with a hyphen and is copied as printed.
